items.name: AnyPay
items.title: AnyPay: digital finance for Malaysian MSMEs
items.award: Platinum Award (Best of the Best), DIGITEX 2026, Faculty of Computing UTM, among 120 finalists
items.short: Platinum Award winner. A mobile-first financial platform for small businesses.
items.description: A mobile-first financial platform for Malaysian micro, small and medium enterprises: LHDN-compliant invoicing with automatic SST, financial tracking and ESG-aware features. I led the team, which won the top honour at DIGITEX 2026.

items.name: AnyPOS
items.title: AnyPOS: smart point of sale for MSMEs
items.award: Finalist and consolation prize, PayHack 2025 (PayNet and Ant International)
items.short: PayHack 2025 finalist. A POS that also handles analytics, tax and credit.
items.description: More than a point-of-sale system: real-time sales analytics, automated LHDN tax filing and credit score support in one platform for underserved Malaysian businesses. Built by team AnyPay at PayHack 2025.

items.name: Retention Command
items.title: Retention Command: an onboarding and retention AI employee
items.award: Autopilot Asia Hackathon 2026, Track 5 (HR and People Ops)
items.short: AI agents that watch a new hire's first 90 days and ask a human before sensitive moves.
items.description: An orchestrator and operator agents on Supervity Auto audit onboarding tasks, read engagement feedback and route reminders or escalations across Supabase, Slack and Outlook. When a case is confidential it pauses for human approval instead of guessing.

items.name: BizView
items.title: BizView: MSME business intelligence and loan pre-check
items.short: AI-powered business insights and loan pre-eligibility for small businesses.
items.description: A SaaS-style web app giving Malaysian MSMEs AI-powered business intelligence, loan pre-eligibility assessment and analytics. Built with Next.js and FastAPI.

items.name: AI Mystery Shopper
items.title: AI Mystery Shopper: autonomous Android app testing
items.award: Built for the Deriv AI Hackathon
items.short: An AI that explores and tests mobile apps on its own.
items.description: Combines computer vision (OmniParser) with large language models to parse app screens, decide what to tap next and test Android apps without a human driving.

items.name: KolejCare
items.title: KolejCare: facility complaints and maintenance
items.short: A Flutter app for reporting and fixing campus facility issues.
items.description: Role-based Flutter and Firebase app for students, staff, technicians and admins, with real-time complaint tracking and AI-assisted categorisation and urgency.

items.name: Mental Health Hub
items.title: ElanSere Mental Health Hub
items.short: A university mental health support platform.
items.description: Self-assessments, appointment booking, consultations, peer forums and analytics dashboards for university students. Built with Spring Boot and Thymeleaf.

files.name: Personnel file
body: Hello! I'm Chew Zhuo Heng, a software engineering student at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (2023 to 2027), currently an R&D Software Engineering Intern at Billion Prima Sdn Bhd.
I like building things that bridge technology and real problems, especially in fintech and AI, and I learn fastest under a hackathon deadline.
Before UTM I studied engineering at Kolej Matrikulasi Kejuruteraan Johor, graduating with a 4.0.
When I'm not coding, I enjoy playing sports, watching movies, and anything to do with cars.

secretFile.name: Behind the scenes
body: You found every ink ribbon. Here is how this room was made.
Everything was modelled and lit in Blender, then the lighting was baked into two images, one for day and one for night, so the room looks rendered while running smoothly in a browser.
The website is plain JavaScript with Three.js. Ziggy, the plant and the furniture models are free assets from Sketchfab and Poly Haven, credited at the bottom of the normal view.
